caption: The drawing features three illustrations of the same oval object, likely a cameo or medallion, each shown from a different perspective. The topmost illustration presents the front view of the object, depicting a detailed relief of two human figures, one on horseback and the other standing or walking beside, set against an orange background. The left-side illustration displays the back of the object, showing a smooth, marbled pink surface with a thin gold or brass border and a horizontal hinge or clasp. The right-most illustration shows a side profile of the object, revealing its thickness and the raised relief on the front, as well as a small protruding knob or clasp. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and the objects are rendered with fine lines and muted colors including orange, pink, gray, white, and gold. A small artist’s signature, "M. Fenga," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Cameo Brooch
